run_explorer: run the explorer function to launch SLURM jobs training clip_conv models on varying numbers of gwilliams2022 subjects
run_clipexplorer: run the ClipExplorer decorator to configure WER and WER vocab test metrics for grid search experiments
run_bmexplorer: run the BMExplorer base class to define grid metrics layout and process training history for brainmagick experiments
run_launcher_slurm: run launcher.slurm_ to configure GPU count, memory per GPU, and SLURM partition for experiment jobs
run_launcher_job_array: run launcher.job_array to iterate over seeds and datasets submitting parameter sweeps as a SLURM job array
